motif: One glowing Fogo Dourado (gold-orange) seam splitting each body along a vertical or diagonal crack, with a notch/void cut into the silhouette. Stratified stone layers form the body, so the race reads as a fractured, layered geology.

buildings.why: Altar chain is a ziggurat: low split slab at h045, wider V-fissure with a crown here, then the tall stratigraphic stack at h04E.
Base of the Altar chain: a low, flat stepped slab with an orange tear. Colour differs from its neighbours.
Two open shale slabs make a low V gate. The chain's h06F (low arch) and h06E (angled sling) both grow from this.
A fulgurite rod raked about 30 degrees on a wide pedestal. The tilt is the identifier, and the pale body contrasts with the dark towers around it.
A low, thick fist of three compressed strata holding a boulder, the opposite of the Discharge needle.
Seam-collapse arch with falling shale and water. It keeps the Books chain's arch and the water gives it a cold colour.
A broken annular basin with dark water behind smoked glass. It is the Water Spring chain's pit, grown.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Rock Pile chain: the cairn's three blocks grow into two tall stratum walls forming a V ravine. Ochre separates it from the brown cairn.
A radial ring around a broken obelisk with cracks reaching every sector, which reads as a flat star.
A horizontal nerve between two slabs with a quartz capacitor. Brass is the dieselpunk accent hue.
Two shale slabs as a diagonal sling, an angled variant of the Books chain's gate. Hot debris colour distinguishes it from h05Z and h06F.
Trapped Gale chain is a ring: the horseshoe closes at h04A, becomes a crescent arch here, and ruptures at h04D.
A simple vertical obelisk cracked into four plates around a void. The Arco Elétrico cyan makes it distinct.
A short, thick column on a compressed charcoal base, split into a Y fork. The drum body keeps it distinct from the tower and the tilted rod.
The drum grows five fanned needles, wider rather than taller. The bone colour shows the upgrade against the charcoal base.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: A low cairn of three blocks, the heaviest and simplest form in the race, with an orange crack and the wedge void.
Three overlapping broken basins around a mirrored void form a low crown. It is the Water Spring chain's pit at its largest.
A very tall stack of displaced slabs around a void with a broken halo. It grows the Altar ziggurat into the race's top landmark.
A low basalt horseshoe almost fully closed over an ash pocket: a ring with a tiny gap, with the dart slot cut into the mouth.
A low basalt depression with one blade of dark water. Moss green is a living hue that stands apart from the stone around it.
The ruptured end of the Gale chain: a split obelisk with two crescent plates as fossil wings around an opening. It is the ring's final, broken state.
